summary: Fossil taxonomy and ages are open via the PBDB API, and clade-specific fossil+extant matrices are scattered across Dryad/Zenodo/Figshare (one example verified: Gavialis, 164 characters). MorphoBank, the main repository, returned 403 for every URL, so its holdings could not be checked. No pooled cross-clade dataset exists.
next_step: Pick 3-5 clades with fossil+extant matrices (Dryad/Zenodo or MorphoBank when reachable), pre-register an intermediacy metric and a random-extinction null.
obstacles_confirmed: Matrices are clade-specific and unevenly published
Stem placement may be circular with tree-based coding
